user_problem: One approved message must be adapted across formats while preserving meaning, qualifiers, and CTA constraints.
unique_output: A channel-by-channel brief specifying retained elements, length budget, allowable compression, format cues, and omissions.
required_input: Approved source message, channel constraints, required qualifiers, permitted CTA, and protected phrases.
critical_rule: Compression must not remove material qualification or create a stronger claim than the approved message.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is message-asset-reuse-map; this plans format-specific adaptation rather than locating existing message reuse.
acceptance_scenario: Input message says 'Pilot teams cut setup time by 20% in May,' qualifier must remain, CTA 'Read pilot notes,' limits 60 and 120 words. Output preserves pilot and May in both formats.
